skip: The article has about 250 words of substance (birth at Phulia, family, the naming story, studies, the debated 'King of Gauda'), part of it garbled (it has him translate the Mahabharata too). Not enough for 260 words without padding. Usable facts if wanted: c. 1381 - c. 1461; born in a Kulin Brahmin family at Phulia, Nadia; eldest of Banamali Ojha's six sons and one daughter; the king who honoured him is debated (Raja Ganesha, or per R. C. Majumdar Ruknuddin Barbak Shah); the work is the Sriram Panchali, edited by Jaygopal Tarkalankar for the Serampore Mission Press.
